{"subject":"Onboarding vCluster's new AEs and SDRs","body":"Hi Laurie,

I saw vCluster has 7 sales roles open, including Federal Account Executive and Enterprise Account Executive, plus SDR roles in NYC and the SF Bay Area. Headcount is also up 17.3% in six months.

Quillpath is an AI pipeline-review assistant. It reads your CRM every night, flags stalled deals (no activity, missing next step, slipped close date), and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. That could help new reps ramp on a consistent pipeline process. It connects to HubSpot or Salesforce in about 15 minutes, read-only, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to run a free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline before the new reps start?","missing":["Which CRM vCluster uses (HubSpot or Salesforce)","Whether vCluster has a RevOps person or an existing pipeline review process","Any information on Laurie's specific responsibilities for the federal or enterprise teams"]}
